tasks.name: Frontend UI
tasks.description:
Create a simple HTML page with a form to input and save notes. Display the list of saved notes fetched from the API.

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {content: str}) -> {id, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, content, created_at}]

tasks.name: Backend API
tasks.description:
Implement the backend API endpoints to handle saving and retrieving notes.

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {content: str}) -> {id, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, content, created_at}]

tasks.name: Database Models
tasks.description:
Define the Note model and database schema to store and retrieve notes.

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {content: str}) -> {id, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, content, created_at}]

tasks.name: Testing
tasks.description:
Write tests for the frontend, backend, and database to ensure the application works as expected.

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {content: str}) -> {id, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, content, created_at}]

tasks.name: Deployment
tasks.description:
Set up deployment configuration to host the application on a server or cloud platform.

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {content: str}) -> {id, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, content, created_at}]

T1.implementation_approach: Design and develop the user interface using a framework like React or Angular, ensuring responsiveness and user-friendly navigation.
T1.notes: Focus on accessibility and cross-browser compatibility.

T2.implementation_approach: Build RESTful APIs using a backend framework like Node.js or Django to handle business logic and data exchange.
T2.notes: Ensure proper authentication and error handling.

T3.implementation_approach: Define database schemas and models using an ORM like Sequelize or Django ORM to manage data storage and relationships.
T3.notes: Optimize for scalability and data integrity.

T4.implementation_approach: Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests using tools like Jest or Selenium to ensure functionality and reliability.
T4.notes: Automate testing as part of the CI/CD pipeline.

T5.implementation_approach: Deploy the application using platforms like AWS, Heroku, or Docker, ensuring proper environment configuration and monitoring.
T5.notes: Set up continuous deployment for seamless updates.
